title: iOS 27 gives Apple Mail my most wished for feature upgrade - 9to5Mac
summary: Apple’s Mail app in iOS 27 promises to offer the feature upgrade that’s been at the top of my wishlist for years: search that “just works.” Apple’s Mail app has long been plagued by lackluster search.
